text:
Predicates:
Winner(x, y) ::: x is the winner of the year y.
Participant(x, y) ::: x participated in the year y.
LeaderboardTie(x, y) ::: There was a tie involving x on the leaderboard of the year y.
FromCountry(x, y) ::: x is from the country y.
OnLeaderboard(x, y) ::: x is on the leaderboard of the year y.
AllOnLeaderboardParticipated(y) ::: All people on the leaderboard of the year y participated in that year y.
Premises:
Winner(steinhauer, 1992) ::: The winner of the 1992 du Maurier Classic was Steinhauer.
Participant(steinhauer, 1992) ::: Steinhauer participated in the 1992 du Maurier Classic.
∃x (LeaderboardTie(x, 1992) ∧ FromCountry(x, belgium)) ::: There was one six-way tie on the leaderboard and one person in the six-way tie was from Belgium.
FromCountry(descampe, belgium) ∧ OnLeaderboard(descampe, 1992) ::: Descampe is from Belgium and is on the leaderboard of the 1992 du Maurier Classic.
∀x (OnLeaderboard(x, 1992) → Participant(x, 1992)) ::: All people on the leaderboard of the 1992 du Maurier Classic participated in the 1992 du Maurier Classic.
Conclusion:
LeaderboardTie(descampe, 1992) ::: Descampe is in the six-way tie in the leaderboard of the 1992 du Maurier Classic.
